seo.title: Walk-Ins or Appointments? A Barbershop Owner's Guide
seo.description: Why barbershop waiting times grow so fast as the shop gets busy, what walk-aways and empty slots really cost, and how to choose walk-ins, bookings or both.

media.anchor: Going from 80% busy to 90% busy, only ten percentage points
media.alt: Original chart showing modelled average queue waits of 7, 19, 36 and 85 minutes when a two-barber shop has 50%, 70%, 80% and 90% utilisation, using 20-minute average cuts
media.caption: Illustrative M/M/2 queueing model, not observed shop data: two always-available barbers, a 20-minute average cut, random independent arrivals and exponentially distributed service times

media.anchor: **Hybrid.** This is a common model and the hardest to run well.
